about: Five hard lines, the same for every model and method in the shoot-out (docs/voice/samples). Each has its part (whose cast reference the cloning methods use), the words as a model should be given them, a short style, a performance description for voice-design methods, an IndexTTS emotion vector (happy, angry, sad, afraid, disgusted, melancholic, surprised, calm), a Chatterbox exaggeration, a Dia script with its non-verbal cues, and an Orpheus script with its tags.

1_angry.text: Dealt with. That's what you said. I paid you thirty of the Watch's gold for dealt with, and this morning I had a drover bleeding on my gate. So. Tell me why you shouldn't spend the night in the fucking cells.
1_angry.style: cold fury held just below the surface, clipped and hoarse, slow and dangerous
1_angry.act: He is furious and holding it down: low, clipped, biting each word, a dangerous pause after 'So.', and the swear at the end landing hard and quiet.
1_angry.dia: [S1] Dealt with. That's what you said. I paid you thirty of the Watch's gold for dealt with, and this morning I had a drover bleeding on my gate. (sighs) So. Tell me why you shouldn't spend the night in the fucking cells.
orpheus: Dealt with. That's what you said. I paid you thirty of the Watch's gold for dealt with, and this morning I had a drover bleeding on my gate. <sigh> So. Tell me why you shouldn't spend the night in the fucking cells.

2_intimate.text: Put your purse away. Tonight I'm not working. ...Don't look at me like that. Don't make it strange.
2_intimate.style: soft and intimate, unsure of herself, close to the ear, gentle and a little shy
2_intimate.act: She is close and quiet, unsure of herself for once: the first two sentences soft and warm, then a nervous little laugh before 'Don't look at me like that', and the last sentence almost a plea.
2_intimate.dia: [S1] Put your purse away. Tonight I'm not working. (laughs) Don't look at me like that. Don't make it strange.
orpheus: Put your purse away. Tonight I'm not working. <chuckle> Don't look at me like that. Don't make it strange.

3_wry.text: Holloway thinks he does. Vonra knows she does. Pell's got it written down in a book somewhere, with interest. And I feed all three of them, so you can draw your own conclusions.
3_wry.style: sly and dry, amused, a laugh on the out-breath at the end
3_wry.act: She is sly and amused, enjoying herself: each verdict drier than the last, a scornful lift on 'with interest', and a short laugh on the out-breath at the end.
3_wry.dia: [S1] Holloway thinks he does. Vonra knows she does. Pell's got it written down in a book somewhere, with interest. And I feed all three of them, so you can draw your own conclusions. (laughs)
orpheus: Holloway thinks he does. Vonra knows she does. Pell's got it written down in a book somewhere, with interest. And I feed all three of them, so you can draw your own conclusions. <chuckle>

4_grief.text: Had the reins. She'd want the reins. Always wanted the reins.
4_grief.style: broken with grief, barely holding together, very slow and quiet, deep
4_grief.act: He has just learned his daughter is dead. Barely voiced and very slow, a long breath before the second sentence, his voice cracking with grief on 'Always wanted the reins'.
4_grief.dia: [S1] (sighs) Had the reins. She'd want the reins. Always wanted the reins.
orpheus: <sigh> Had the reins. She'd want the reins. <sniffle> Always wanted the reins.

5_shout.text: Pack it up! Pack it up! Leave the heavy stuff!
5_shout.style: bellowing orders in alarm, shouting at full voice, urgent
5_shout.act: A bandit chief bellowing at his camp in sudden alarm: shouting at the top of his voice, urgent and rough.
5_shout.dia: [S1] Pack it up! Pack it up! Leave the heavy stuff!
orpheus: Pack it up! Pack it up! Leave the heavy stuff!
